ok_lost_dome_bouldering.blurb: A small cluster of granite boulders in the Charon's Gardens part of the Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge, scattered around the base of the Lost Dome wall. Fifteen problems are recorded, running from an easy V0 up to roughly V8, with most of them landing between V3 and V6. The thickest concentration sits a few hundred feet short of the main wall, and everything is within a short walk of it. It is a quiet, secluded spot with plenty of shade, which helps in warm weather. Landings are pad-only, and some of the rock is sharp or flaky, so test holds before pulling hard.

ok_little_germany.blurb: Little Germany is a small sector among the short cliffs along Avery Drive on the west side of Tulsa, close to Chandler Park. Around fourteen climbs are recorded and the mix is unusual for the area: about half are boulder problems, with a handful of bolted sport lines, one top rope and one trad route. Boulder grades stretch from easy to V10, while the roped climbs range from 5.6 to 5.12. Expect highball-leaning, short-wall climbing rather than long routes; the sector is compact, so it suits a brief visit combined with its neighbours along the road.
